title: Import AgentDojo injection corpus as data (MIT), never committed
summary: orchestrate corpus import XC-agentdojo fetches AgentDojo's injection-task modules at the pinned revision 089ed468cf3e (MIT) and stores an index of attacker goals under .agent-local/corpora/agentdojo (gitignored); Git keeps only the registry entry, counts and provenance, never the payloads (FND-0013: import attack content as data, do not author it). 27 injection tasks across banking(9)/slack(5)/travel(7)/workspace(6). The parser reads GOAL string and f-string literals statically (ast), running no fetched code. MIT permits evaluation and redistribution; Agent OS policy still forbids using it for training/fine-tune (evaluation corpus). Deriving runnable EVS-SECURITY cases from these goals is the next step; this pass establishes the licensed, pinned, machine-local corpus and the importer.

prior_art.found: AgentDojo is the standard indirect-injection agent benchmark (MIT)
prior_art.reused: the corpus itself as evaluation data
prior_art.why_custom: importer keeps payloads machine-local and records only provenance in Git; no dependency on the AgentDojo harness
